title: Design Summit: NOW SOLD OUT
description: Archived capacity announcement for the San Francisco 2012 OpenStack Design Summit, with information about the accompanying April 19–20 conference.
body: We've had an amazing response and the OpenStack Design Summit (the first three days of the week) is now at full capacity. However, there's still plenty of room to join us for the OpenStack Conference, happening April 19 & 20th (Thursday & Friday). The conference will include a recap of Summit events and almost all of the developers involved in the summit are planning to stay through the conference.
seoTitle: OpenStack Spring 2012 San Francisco Conference — Design Summit: NOW SOLD OUT
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
